config.world_role: development only; never pool into independent confirmation
config.C_generator: a=1+log(3), z1 N(0,1.2), z2,z3 independent N(0,1)
config.O_generator: a uniform[-2,.8], z=r*d, r N(0,1.2); shared a,r,Uniform labels and nested prefix across ordinary sizes
config.preprocessing: identity coordinates fixed before pilot; no O/C/Q/T fitted transformation
config.lr_loss: sum logistic loss plus ridge/2 times squared norm, including intercept; C=1/ridge fixed
config.solver: adaptive singleton gain per cost; same updates, limits, stopping and stable ID ties; only O conditioning differs
config.cost_order_environment: absolute target coordinate; no learner or evaluation score used; EAD and final cost multiset fixed
config.primary_metric: excess Brier against known p; sampled Brier retained separately
config.I: D-only exploration gain at O=4000 minus at O=500; same D-only select_hash across both O sizes
config.delta_role: prospective development planning loss unit only; confirmatory threshold must be frozen before fresh confirmation
config.inference: world-level paired differences; exploratory t intervals, Holm p and Bonferroni intervals; n=6 is variance pilot, no promotion or confirmation
config.planning: use upper 95 percent bound for world contrast standard deviation plus registered three-comparison multiplicity; no effect-based sample extension

effective_EAD: cost/0.75, exposure multiset preserved while individual exposure pairing changes
budget_interpretation: sum business-model PD times effective EAD, not a realized loss guarantee
comparators: D-only/PA are classic target-weighted information design instances; Static versions isolate batch updating; GainBudget-Pending is a raw marginal gain under feasibility comparator, not a reproduction of ConBatch-BAL or ParBaLS
claim_scope: cost-pairing mechanism in original M3 anchor, no new SOTA/ParBaLS superiority or full overall-plan completion claim
stop_rule: all fixed registered worlds once; no interim significance testing, no outcome-based extension or selected costs/learners
terminal_rule: at registered N report support, reverse, effect excluded, equivalence or unresolved. Completed bounded study never means all mechanisms positive or identified.

planning.rule: max across learners of [z_(1-.04/4) * upper95_SD / .0001]^2; chi-square Gaussian SD bound; cap fixed before pilot; use first4 of8 label reps to match confirmation variance, never use effect mean
